en.html:
Like an <ruby>evil burden<rt>possessing spirit</rt></ruby> lifted, perhaps.
My own lightness of body and mind bewildered me.

Alive. That was all I felt.
No added value attached.
Small. Not weighty. Somebody and nobody.
Simply alive.

...Had I, in the end, been arrogant?
Only now accepting myself at my actual size?
I thought so.

Heaven's way.
A phrase from last night returned.

<ruby>憑物<rt>つきもの</rt></ruby>が落ちた心地、と云うのだろうか。
　心身の軽さは、我が事ながら戸惑う程だった。

　生きている。
　ただ、そう感じる。

　そこに付加価値は何も無い。

　小さく。
　重からず。
　何者でもあり、何者でもなく。

　ただ生きている。

　……とどのつまり。
　自分は傲慢だったのかと、思う。

　等身大の自分自身を、今ようやく認めているのか。
　そう思う。

　――天道。
　昨夜聞いた一語を思い出す。

en.html: If human guilt was for heaven—and the judgment of the world belowearthly world reflecting it—to decide, perhaps my personally pronouncing upon it was itself presumptuous.◆ Was that it? Probably... so. One day I would be judged. I believed the day of reckoning would come. Believing— I would live.
en.text:
If human guilt was for heaven—and the judgment of the world belowearthly world reflecting it—to decide, perhaps my personally pronouncing upon it was itself presumptuous.◆
Was that it?

Probably... so.
One day I would be judged. I believed the day of reckoning would come.

Believing—
I would live.
